engine: gapsystudio's services type-pair — a small HANDWRITTEN SCRIPT overline (in quotes) sits ABOVE a HUGE CONDENSED display title; on scroll-into-view the script fades + lifts in first, then the display title reveals LINE BY LINE from a bottom mask (inner translateY 100%->0 + opacity, line-staggered), then the body + CTA fade-rise. The pair anchors one side of an alternating L/R section (text-left/visual-right, then swapped via .sodp--rtl). Harvested from D_gapsy (D /services: 'Mobile App Design', 'Motion Design', 'Brand Design', 'Web Design', 'Visual Identity Design', each with a quoted script overline).

measured_teardown.move: scroll-into-view, one play, progress p 0..1. Script overline: opacity 0->1 + translateY 12px->0 over 0.00..0.30. Display title: JS wraps each .sodp-line's text in a .sodp-line-in inner span; the .sodp-line is overflow:hidden (the mask), the inner rises translateY 100%->0 + opacity, each line in its own window over 0.15..0.80 (line-staggered, power3.out). Body + CTA: opacity 0->1 + translateY 16px->0 over 0.70..1.00. set(p) is a PURE scrub.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung... NO — gapsy /services: a handwritten script overline in quotes (e.g. 'Designing Mobile Apps That Make Life Easier!') above a huge condensed display title ('Mobile App Design'), body + 'View More' pill, the section alternating text/visual L<->R; a floating red-pedestal product on the other side (separate brick floating-product-orbit).

lineStagger.what: spacing between display-title lines in the bottom-mask ladder (added to the play timeline length).

duration.what: base reveal duration; total play = duration + lineStagger*lineCount.

ease.what: the reveal curve (script lift, line rise, body) — power3.out = strong settle. power2.out / expo.out available.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start — when the section is far enough in to play.

once.what: play once (true) or replay on re-enter / reset on leave-back (false).

manageLenis.what: if true and Lenis is present, the component owns a Lenis instance + ticker; set false when the page already drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: ScriptOverlineDisplayPair.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target = .sodp-stage > .sodp-copy(.sodp-script + .sodp-title with [.sodp-line] x N + .sodp-body + .sodp-cta) [+ .sodp-visual aside]. Add .sodp--rtl on the stage to swap sides. JS auto-wraps each .sodp-line in a mask + inner span. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub.
law: transform: translateY (script, line-inner, body, cta) + opacity + overflow:hidden clip (the line mask) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (revealed, no play). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view reveal). The L/R alternation is CSS grid order; the engine only drives the copy reveal, not the visual aside. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for scroll; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (triggered timeline, not a pin). Verify: script fades+lifts first; display lines rise from a bottom mask (translateY 100%->0) line-staggered; body+CTA come last; .sodp--rtl swaps the layout. Smoothness via the scroll-into-view path.
proven: lab: 2 alternating sections on OUR QUADRO renders (Веб-дизайн L / Візуальна ідентичність R).
